grok.pulse: Weekend NQ setup after Fri Comp +1.1% bounce: fresh NVDA China headlines (H200 licenses to shell-like Chinese buyers, Huang spy-report briefing Nov 18) plus a mined tanker near Hormuz lean bearish, offset by Trump's Iran-talks line and Hormuz still open into Mon and Tue CPI.
grok.bias: risk-off — NVDA governance/export-control headlines and Hormuz mine/drone incidents pile onto a tape still in correction (S&P -2.7% wk), with only Iran-talks hopes and Fri's bounce as cushions.
items: @WatcherGuru (~6:10 AM ET): NYT — US approved NVDA H200 sales to Chinese firms with empty offices and blacklist ties — Bearish NQ
@FirstSquawk (~5:16 AM ET): Iran navy says oil tanker hit a mine in Hormuz Sat; Iran also claims it downed a US MQ-9 over Qeshm (~5:56 AM ET) — Bearish NQ
X News (~7:14 AM ET): FT spy-link story on Jensen Huang; House committees want closed-door briefing with Huang Nov 18, NVDA internal review found no wrongdoing — Bearish NQ
X News (~2:30 AM ET): TSMC drawing up 3D DRAM plans at NVDA's request amid AI memory shortage — Mixed NQ
@unusual_whales (~12:39 AM ET): Apollo — still no sign of AI in productivity numbers despite capex — Bearish NQ
grok.trump: Overnight remarks: says US has beaten Iran 'without losing a single soldier,' calls it 'the greatest blockade in history,' Hormuz controlled/open and negotiations underway; Fri he said he's 'dealing with the Iranians.'
grok.watch: Weekend Iran/Hormuz and NVDA headlines into Sun 6 PM ET futures open; Mon Nov 9 CEG BMO, TTWO AMC; Tue Nov 10 CPI 8:30 AM ET, CRWV AMC; Thu Nov 12 NBIS BMO, AMAT/CSCO AMC; Fri Nov 13 PPI; Nov 18 Huang House briefing; NVDA Nov 17 AMC; Dec 8-9 FOMC.
